en: The postcard features a monochrome, possibly sepia-toned, illustration or photograph of a richly adorned woman in elaborate traditional attire and jewelry. She is wearing an ornate headdress and is depicted in a classic portrait style. The background is simple and oval-framed, focusing attention on the subject. Below the portrait, there is a handwritten or stylized text that appears to read 'Qajmahallegan'.
